newsitem.title: USA: Cell Genesys sees charge from Somatix merge.
newsitem.headline: Cell Genesys sees charge from Somatix merge.

text.p: Cell Genesys Inc said Monday that it expects to record a nonrecurring and primarily noncash charge to operations estimated at $105 million, related to its merger with Somatix Therapy Corp.
Cell Genesys said that the merger became effective following approval on May 30 at the stockholder meetings of each company.
The company said that Somatix's Alameda site will be closed, and about 30 of Somatix's key research scientists will transfer to Cell Genesys.
The charge includes expenses related to acquired in-process technology and restructuring.
Under the terms of the tax-free stock-for-stock merger, each Somatix share has been converted into 0.385 shares of Cell Genesys stock.
The combined entity, which will be located in existing Cell Genesys facilities in Foster City, Calif., has about 27 million shares outstanding.
